entries.5a8799d1a694d94d: A single-segment company in the product platform business, built on market research through surveys and ad delivery to its own apps.
entries.74925b58c5de0766: A business that builds, on the basis of point functions, a platform with features that enhance product experience value and profitability, and has companies seeking to raise the value and earning power of their products introduce and use it. The company has a single segment, the Product Platform Business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,818 million. Following the absorption-type company split on October 1, 2025, the company became a holding company, and its business is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.a0f2a7645758e7db: A service providing survey execution infrastructure using research panels to client companies with market research needs. It includes an outsourcing service that consistently undertakes the execution of surveys, and a D.I.Y service in which customers conduct surveys themselves. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,631 million.
entries.f88f5fcde5c54784: A service that places and delivers advertisements on media and apps owned by the company group and on media and apps owned by other companies, and provides members (users) with a means of earning points. Advertising revenue increased significantly following the business integration with GMO TownWiFi, Inc. in April 2025. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,166 million.
